usageNotes: Use this as a discovery call to enumerate the available sub-endpoints under /cluster/backup-info (e.g., not-backed-up). It requires no parameters and no special privileges, making it a safe first step before querying specific backup-info child resources. The response is a directory index — follow the 'subdir' values to reach actionable endpoints.
tips: The returned 'subdir' values are relative paths; append them to /cluster/backup-info/ to form the full child endpoint path.
This endpoint is unauthenticated in terms of privilege checks (permissions: null), but a valid API token or ticket is still required to reach the PVE API.
